title: Kirin Holdings Company - proposed acquisition of outstanding shares in Lion Nathan Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Kirin proposed to acquire all of the outstanding shares (approximately 54%) in Lion Nathan.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC noted that there was no significant product overlap between the two parties in Australia.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in any relevant market. In reaching this conclusion, the ACCC considered that the merged entity would be competitively constrained by existing effective competitors.
